run_uncompress_cli: run the uncompress script to decompress S2EF dataset files from an input directory to an output directory
run_read_lzma: run the read_lzma function to decompress a single LZMA compressed file to a specified output path
run_decompress_list_of_files: run the decompress_list_of_files function to decompress a single input-output file pair using LZMA
run_get_parser: run the get_parser function to create an argparse parser with ipdir, opdir, and num-workers arguments
run_main: run the main function to parallel decompress all txt.xz and extxyz.xz files in a directory using multiprocessing
